summary: The diff implements many UI-level optimistic update patterns and pool-tracking concepts, but several critical backend requirements appear missing or incomplete. The frontend resetPool call is stubbed with a setTimeout simulation. The useResetPool hook is absent. Backend atomic pool consumption, stable availablePoolByList, audit log, and proper metadata fields are not evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add a stable availablePoolByList HashMap with preupgrade/postupgrade hooks; initialize pool on list creation; append on template addition; remove on template deletion
missing_requirements.reason: The visible backend code still shows usedTemplateIndices (old approach). No stable availablePoolByList or preupgrade/postupgrade hooks are visible in the truncated main.mo. Pool initialization in addCommentList and pool mutation in addTemplatesToList are not evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Replace generateComment with atomic version consuming shared pool, returning availableBefore/availableAfter/totalTemplates metadata, with device lock via claims HashMap
missing_requirements.reason: useGenerateSingleComment still calls generateBulkComments(listId, 1) rather than a dedicated generateComment(listId, deviceId). No metadata fields (availableBefore, availableAfter, totalTemplates) are handled from the response. Backend atomic pool consumption not evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Replace generateBulkComments with atomic version consuming shared pool, returning generatedCount/availableBefore/availableAfter/totalTemplates metadata; no device lock
missing_requirements.reason: useGenerateBulkComments mutationFn does not pass accessKey to the backend. BulkCommentsResult type does not include availableBefore/availableAfter/totalTemplates. Backend atomic pool consumption not evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update getAvailableCount to return availablePoolByList[listId].size(); update getListMetrics to derive availableTemplates from pool size
missing_requirements.reason: Backend changes not visible in truncated main.mo. No evidence the backend methods have been updated to use pool size.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add resetPool(listId, clearClaims) backend method that restores pool, optionally clears claims, appends audit log, returns Result
missing_requirements.reason: AdminComments.tsx explicitly comments 'resetPool backend method is not yet implemented' and uses a setTimeout simulation instead of calling the actual backend method.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add stable auditLog array to backend; resetPool appends descriptive entry; expose getAuditLog query
missing_requirements.reason: No evidence of stable auditLog variable or getAuditLog query in the backend. resetPool is not implemented in the backend.

missing_requirements.requirement: generateComment mutation must pass deviceId from localStorage; handle availableBefore/availableAfter/totalTemplates metadata; generateBulkComments must handle generatedCount/availableBefore/availableAfter/totalTemplates
missing_requirements.reason: useGenerateSingleComment does not pass deviceId to backend. Neither mutation handles availableBefore or totalTemplates from the response. The BulkCommentsResult type does not include these fields.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add useResetPool mutation hook in useQueries.ts that calls resetPool(listId, clearClaims) and invalidates queries on success
missing_requirements.reason: No useResetPool hook is present in useQueries.ts. AdminComments.tsx does not import or use such a hook.

hallucinated_features.description: AdminComments.tsx simulates resetPool with a 500ms setTimeout instead of calling the backend
hallucinated_features.reason: The spec requires calling the actual resetPool backend method. The implementation stubs this out with a fake async delay and a comment saying the backend method is not yet implemented.

hallucinated_features.description: migration.mo added as an empty pass-through module
hallucinated_features.reason: No migration module was requested in the build requirements. This file adds no functional value and was not specified.

hallucinated_features.description: Frontend-side access key validation in BulkCommentGenerator comparing trimmedKey to storedKey locally before calling backend
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-47 specifies backend access key validation only. The frontend performing its own key check before calling the backend was not requested.
